protocol.implementation_amendment: The initial mixed-length padded run was invalidated by a CUDA batch-versus-single audit: identical prompts changed from correct weekday names to whitespace when padded. Explicit positions did not repair it; all-ones versus omitted masks agreed for single prompts. Rerun at batch 1, prohibit padding, retain every scientific choice and gate. Old run and both audit records remain under .artifacts/gemma-weekdays. Their combined cost counts toward the original cap.
protocol.question: Can compact weekday features support natural-scale causal edits before EML equation fitting?
protocol.budget_accounting: One occupied H100 times elapsed process wall time, including shared-device delays and loading. No concurrent study jobs. Stop between batches at the phase deadline; retain partial records.
formats: Today is {day}. What day of the week will it be {offset} days later? Answer with only the weekday name.
Start on {day} and advance by {offset} days. Give only the resulting weekday.
A meeting happens on {day}. The next meeting is scheduled {offset} days afterward. Name its weekday, without explanation.
protocol.patch_site: Only the last token of the source weekday, at the output of one zero-indexed text block. The source weekday precedes the offset. No answer or future-token activations are patched.
protocol.features: Mean training hidden state per weekday; Fourier contrast matrix at harmonics 1 (rank 2) or 1,2,3 (rank 6), followed by QR. All six contrasts span arbitrary centered weekday means, so rank 6 is a categorical control, not evidence of a circle. No counterfactual-label optimization.
protocol.edits: h + alpha * U U^T (h_donor - h), with a natural donor from the same offset and format. Alpha=1 for the gate. Full-state natural donor patch is the positive control. Random control uses a seeded direction orthogonal to U, matched to each realized semantic edit's norm.
protocol.scoring: Unconditional full-vocabulary first-token argmax. Weekday names must each be one token. Restricted seven-name accuracy and logit margins are diagnostics. Paired results cluster both donor shifts and all formats by (source weekday, offset); exploratory 95% cluster bootstrap intervals, not population guarantees.

gate.selection: Among passing layer/rank pairs, choose lowest rank, then highest new-format target accuracy, then earliest layer. This is a development screen, not confirmation.

protocol.stopping: Stop this direction if no feature passes. Do not increase edit scale, train new directions, change prompts, or fit EML after inspecting a failure in this run. If a feature passes, freeze a separate equation protocol before fitting; compare EML with linear, polynomial, Fourier/bilinear, and conventional symbolic regression. Hold out new contexts, offsets and edit strengths; use three search seeds. Total combined budget remains one H100-hour.

formats: It is {day} when a trip begins. After {offset} days have elapsed, which weekday is it? Reply with the name alone.
On {day}, set a timer for exactly {offset} days. On which weekday does it finish? Only output that weekday.
confirmation_reserved.access: Not rendered, run, or scored in the prerequisite screen.

protocol.limits: Natural donor inference is allowed for causal experiments, not a deployable replacement. A successful source-token patch establishes controllability of an input representation, not a recovered addition or modulo algorithm. Seven weekday labels constrain geometric claims. Previously inspected Gemma arithmetic remains development evidence.

plan.selection_role: None; do not reopen the failed gate
plan.hypothesis: A source-only block-output edit at or after the last KV writer cannot affect other token positions when all subsequent attention layers reuse earlier KV and remaining operations are tokenwise.
plan.checks: Check nonzero source-state replacement and unchanged other positions. Require bitwise equality of all next-token logits after edits at layers 14 and 17, under both backends. Test mixed-length padding against an explicit causal mask and single prompts. These checks diagnose implementation and topology, not new semantic features.

previous_audit_attempts.reason: Audit referenced a KV-source attribute from a different installed Transformers copy; pinned 5.16.1 indexes shared states by attention type. Corrected the diagnostic to derive writers from live modules.
previous_audit_attempts.accounting: Conservative 60-second charge for startup, loading, exception and teardown; exceeds the recorded log lifetime.

previous_audit_attempts.reason: Handwritten additive mask left padding-query rows entirely masked, allowing nonfinite logits. Give padding queries a self-attention row while keeping padding keys inaccessible to real tokens. No change to the screen or gate.
previous_audit_attempts.accounting: Conservative 60-second charge for startup, loading, diagnostics, exception and teardown.

budget_accounting_note: CUDA-runner elapsed time includes setup, loading and shared-device delays. Each of two failed posthoc diagnostics is conservatively charged 60 seconds. CPU-only code editing and initial Python imports are excluded. No EML search or fresh confirmation was run.

failure_analysis.native_task_gate: 53/84 full-vocabulary first-token answers were correct (63.1%; cluster bootstrap 95% 47.6–77.4). Complete generated-answer accuracy was not measured. Offset 13 was wrong in all 21 development prompts; the gate cannot certify a reliable native arithmetic task.
failure_analysis.observational_vs_causal: The rank-6 weekday basis decodes the source weekday with 100% development nearest-prototype accuracy at layers 4 and 10. Counterfactual answer rates remain 11.9–13.1%. Observational decodability does not establish mediation.
failure_analysis.positive_control: Even a complete natural donor state at the same source-token site yields only 13.7%, 13.1%, and 11.3% target accuracy at layers 4, 10, and 17. Basis capacity alone cannot explain this failure; the source-only intervention interface itself is inadequate.
failure_analysis.late_layer_topology: The final 20 blocks share KV written at layers 13 and 14. Editing only a nonfinal source-token block output at or after block 14 changes neither stored KV nor queries at other positions. Later attention and tokenwise operations therefore cannot transmit this edit to the answer position. Twelve finite edits across three prompts and two backends left all output logits bitwise unchanged; six layer-13 control edits changed logits.
failure_analysis.earlier_layer_hypothesis: Earlier blocks may have already copied source information into other prompt positions, which remain unedited. The failed full-state positive control is consistent with this, but the screen did not localize those alternative paths.
failure_analysis.geometric_scope: The six Fourier contrasts span all centered means of seven labels; this is a categorical control. Capturing all weekday mean variation does not cover within-label or context variation and does not establish a circle or arithmetic algorithm.
failure_analysis.operator_scope: No EML function was fitted because the prerequisite gate failed. This run supplies no EML-versus-SiLU or EML-versus-symbolic efficiency comparison.
failure_analysis.runtime_scope: Mixed-length padding produced inconsistent outputs in pinned SDPA; single-prompt results were used. Eager attention preserved the two audited padded answers. The kernel-level cause remains unresolved; no shared runtime or dependency was changed.
